exposure: Autoimmune diseases (Systemic Lupus Erythematosus, Antiphospholipid Syndrome, Non-criteria-obstetric Antiphospholipid Syndrome) with Adverse Perinatal Outcomes (APO)
Autoimmune diseases (Systemic Lupus Erythematosus, Antiphospholipid Syndrome, Non-criteria-obstetric Antiphospholipid Syndrome) without Adverse Perinatal Outcomes (APO)
Fetal Growth Restriction (FGR) without Autoimmune Disease
outcome: Placental expression of complement proteins (C5b-9, C3b, C4d)
cohort: Placental tissue samples were obtained from patients diagnosed with autoimmune diseases (with and without adverse perinatal outcomes), patients with fetal growth restriction without autoimmune disease, and healthy control individuals.
finding: Placentas from autoimmune disease patients, especially those with adverse perinatal outcomes, exhibited excessive complement activation (higher C5b-9, C3b, C4d) and reduced Annexin V expression compared to controls, with elevated PlGF placental expression noted in autoimmune disease patients without adverse perinatal outcomes.
cross-section timing: Placental samples were collected, implying collection at birth or immediately postpartum.
